subject: Cierra - composite retention package (discount + SLA + credit) - approval request
messages:
From: Ariana Lopez <ariana.lopez@cierra.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-29T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Contract renewal — need final terms by EOD

Jasmine / Marissa,

Thanks for the call this morning. We reviewed the draft SOW and pricing with the finance team and have a couple of last asks before we can sign: a modest price reset for year 1 to reflect reduced Q4 usage, a one-time credit to cover migration of logs, and an SLA addendum guaranteeing 99.9% availability for the inference endpoint (we can accept standard credit tiers).

If Redwood can provide a 15% term-one discount, a $40k one-time migration credit, and the SLA addendum for the 12-month renewal, we will sign and roll forward. We appreciate the partnership — this is time sensitive.

Best,
Ariana
VP, Platform Engineering, Cierra.ai

Attachment: Cierra_feedback_2028-09-29.pdf (stub)

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-29T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Contract renewal — need final terms by EOD

Jasmine — forwarding Ari's ask. Quick context: Cierra is a mid-market ARR account (~$1.1M ARR), trending flat this year. They threatened to multi-cloud a portion of traffic if we don't move. They need an executive-level concession for the migration credit plus a term-based discount. I suggested a performance-linked SLA for the inference endpoint (their critical path is low-latency gen).

I tried to push to a 10% discount + $25k credit but Ari pushed back. They want 15% + $40k. We have some room with a blended retention package but I need approval to offer (a) 12-month term reset at 15% year-1 (b) one-time $40k credit applied to first invoice (c) SLA addendum 99.9% with step-down credits capped at $60k annual.

Attachments: concession_summary_CI4821.xlsx

Can you loop in deal desk and signoff? Vivek - I need your guidance/okay for exec approval path.

—Marissa

From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, priyom.das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-29T18:20:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: Cierra (DEAL-CI-4821) — approval request for composite concession package

Vivek, Priyom — escalating for urgent exec OK. Summary: Cierra (customer) will churn unless we provide the package below. Financials: current committed ARR $1.1M, expected YoY renewal ~$900k without concession. Net retention impact if we lose: strategic mid-market reference and pipeline impact in FinOps vertical.

Proposed concession (requested by AE):
- 15% one-year price reset (applies to base SKU for first 12 months)
- One-time migration credit: $40,000 applied to invoice 1
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime for inference endpoints, step-down credits per standard table, aggregate credit cap $60,000/yr
- Condition: Cierra signs 12-month commitment and agrees to minimum monthly usage baseline (agreed in SOW).

Risk/mitigation:
- Revenue hit in Y1 ~ $135k realized discount + $40k credit = ~$175k impact; mitigated by retention of $900k+ ARR and upsell opportunity in Q1.
- SLA risk modeled with limits and cap. Engineering has validated feasibility of 99.9% on their current topology (note: additional support hours may be scoped separately).

Items for approval:
1) Approve the composite concession as proposed
2) Authorize Finance to book the $40k as a one-time contra-credit
3) Legal to finalize SLA addendum and signoff on cap

I am attaching the concession spreadsheet and draft SLA addendum. Requesting decision by 09/30 11:00 PT to meet procurement window.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive (Retention), Redwood Inference

Attachments: concession_summary_CI4821.xlsx; supporting_sla_addendum.docx

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine.liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, priyom.das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-29T19:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Cierra (DEAL-CI-4821) — approval request for composite concession package

Thanks for the clear write-up, Jasmine. I'm supportive of a structured retention package here given the reference value and minimal technical exposure. I have two asks before I can escalate for final exec sign-off (CFO / Head of Sales):
1) A short one-pager (for execs) that shows net retained revenue after concession, payback timeline, and the list of mitigating contract terms (baseline usage, early termination clawback on credits).
2) Legal to confirm SLA language is standard and credit cap enforceable (Priyom, can you confirm?)

If we get those two items in the next 3 hours I will present this to the revenue committee and push for approval. Consider this greenlight-to-escalate assuming legal signoff.

- Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: priyom.das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine.liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, vivek.kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-09-29T20:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Cierra (DEAL-CI-4821) — legal review note

Reviewed the proposed SLA addendum and concession conditions. Legal comments:
- SLA language is within standard precedent set in prior enterprise addendums; the credit cap of $60k is enforceable and acceptable.
- Recommend adding an explicit clawback clause for the $40k migration credit: if customer terminates within 6 months for convenience, credit is repayable on a pro rata basis.
- Suggest adding reporting cadence for uptime (monthly automated report + quarterly business review).

I can have the redline back to you in 90 minutes.

Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Contracts

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine.liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, priyom.das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-09-30T10:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Cierra (DEAL-CI-4821) — approval (revenue committee)

Team — quick update from revenue committee: approved. Final conditions:
- Approve 15% term-one discount + $40k one-time migration credit (with 6-month pro rata clawback)
- Approve SLA addendum 99.9% with credit cap $60k/yr and monthly uptime reporting
- Require that AE secures signed amendment by 10/07/2028 and monitors usage baseline for 3 months post-renewal

Marissa/Jasmine: please proceed to finalize SOW and publish amendment. Finance will apply credit on invoice 1 after signed amendment is in CRM. Legal will send final redline to customer (Priyom will include clawback language).

Thanks — Vivek
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
